name: get_domain_config
description:
Get the DNS configuration for a domain, including its nameservers, for the authenticated account or selected team. Use projectIdOrName for a domain not yet associated with a project; strict limits nameservers to those assigned directly to the domain.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v6/domains/{domain}/config --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

projectIdOrName.description: The project id or name that will be associated with the domain. Use this when the domain is not yet associated with a project.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

strict.description: When true, the response will only include the nameservers assigned directly to the specified domain. When false and there are no nameservers assigned directly to the specified domain, the response will include the nameservers of the domain's parent zone.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
